summary: Demis Hassabis announced Gemini Robotics 2, a new suite of robotics models that can reason through movements to perform previously unachievable tasks like tying delicate knots and coordinate across multiple robots on complex workflows.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims robots can now perform tasks previously not possible, such as tying delicate knots and multi-robot coordination, though no benchmark or quantified evidence is given.
mechanisms.quote: robots can now reason through every movement to manage tasks that weren’t possible before, like tying delicate knots - and even team up to solve complex workflows

practices.reason: A new robotics model family that reasons through movement and coordinates multi-robot workflows would be worth evaluating for agentic and reasoning-heavy robotics use cases, though no benchmark figures are given.
